title: Documents library
goal: Find a document and open it, or start a new one.
_decisions: pageHeader -> heading + primaryAction: MUI ships no page header, and composing one per screen is cheaper than adding a product component for a single use.
avatar carries no size: MUI's Avatar has no size prop (its `sizes` is the HTML image attribute). Default size on both libraries.

zones.name: header
zones.purpose: Name the screen and offer the one creating action.

zones.name: toolbar
zones.purpose: Narrow the list by text and by status.

zones.name: content
zones.purpose: One row per document with its status.

zones.name: footer
zones.purpose: Move through pages when the set is large.

states.empty: emptyState offering to clear the filters
states.error: inlineMessage tone=danger above the list, with a retry action
states.loading: skeleton holding the shape of the rows

data: documents: id, title, status (draft | review | published), updatedAt
